style.backgroundSystem: only two alternating background systems across the whole set: a matte seamless light studio sweep #F4F5F7 and a deep charcoal matte panel #2B2D31 with a soft top falloff; no third style, no random textures
style.direction: industrial cordless power-tool ecommerce, hard-edged and readable
style.iconSystem: solid circular badges and single thin leader-line callouts in #F2A02A, one graphic device per shot, no illustration, no 3D icons, no certificate artwork
style.lightingSystem: hard directional side key from the left that rakes across metal and moulded shell into long narrow specular streaks, thin rim light from the right to separate silhouette from panel, deep short contact shadow that always grounds the tool, no flat frontal fill
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent industrial cordless power-tool ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of matte studio light grey #F4F5F7, deep charcoal panel #2B2D31 and charcoal text #2D2D2D, with one accent color {accent_color} pinned to tool orange #F2A02A and one soft secondary accent #F2D21B; cool-neutral tone; heavy modern geometric sans-serif with condensed headline weights only; two alternating background systems only, matte light studio sweep and deep charcoal panel, no third style; hard directional side key light from the left raking metal and moulded shell into long narrow specular streaks, thin rim light from the right, deep short contact shadow grounding the tool, no flat frontal fill; visible grain and machining texture, never over-smoothed plastic; solid circular badges and single thin leader-line callouts as the only graphic devices; stable product scale and upright placement, working end pointing left except in the closing shot; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented spec numbers rendered as real values, no fabricated display UI.
noDrift: no mixed fonts or handwritten type
no inconsistent lighting or flipped key direction
no invented voltage, torque, rpm or capacity figures rendered as real numbers
no fabricated display screens, dashboards or app UI
style.presentationRules: tool kept upright and stable with consistent scale across the set, side and 3/4 angles always show the same grip-and-base silhouette, working end points left except in the closing shot, product never floats and always carries a contact shadow
style.surfaceSystem: seamless matte studio sweep; material tiles or moulded ribs where the shot needs a working surface, always with visible grain and machining marks rather than smoothed plastic
style.typography: heavy modern geometric sans-serif with condensed headline weights only, headline 26-42pt, label 13-18pt, Chinese in-image copy wrapped in 「」 and driven by placeholders, hairline rules and one short accent divider as the only decoration
